payslips.title: Payslips
payslips.subtitle: View employees' historical paid payslips from MYOB (read-only)
payslips.cardHint: Read live from MYOB, read-only; filtered by payment date. A payslip has no store of its own: stores are derived from employee matching, the paying company and attendance in the pay period.

rangeError.incomplete: Choose a complete payment date range
rangeError.reversed: The start date cannot be after the end date
rangeError.tooLong: The payment date range is limited to 24 months

notice.title: About store filtering:
notice.body: When an employee works at several stores paid by the same company there is one payslip, shown under each of those stores without splitting the amount. A dashed store tag means there was no attendance in the pay period, so the employee's current store is used.

summary.scope: Totals cover the current filter only

placement.inferredTip: No attendance in this pay period; the employee's current store is used
placement.UnboundHint: This MYOB employee card is not matched to an employee here
placement.UnknownHint: Matched, but no attendance in the period and the current store is not paid by this company

actions.detailAria: View the payslip details of {{name}} paid on {{date}}
actions.goBindAria: Match the MYOB employee card of {{name}}

unassignedBar.message: {{count}} more payslips cannot be assigned to a store
unassignedBar.detail: (the employee is not matched to a MYOB card, or has no store data in the pay period). Visible with the all-stores permission only.

unassignedPage.title: Historical payslips · Unassigned
unassignedPage.hint: These payslips cannot be assigned to a store: the employee is not matched to a MYOB card, or is matched but has no attendance in the pay period and the current store does not match. Visible with the all-stores permission only.
unassignedPage.howTo: For unmatched employees, match the MYOB card on MYOB integration → Employee matching. For "store unknown", check the employee's store assignment, the paying company (MYOB integration → Paying company) and whether there was a roster in the period.

companies.incomplete: The results above do not include employees paid by {{names}}; do not treat them as a complete list.

kinds.reauth: The MYOB authorisation has expired or lacks scope. An administrator of the company file must re-authorise.
kinds.forbidden: This company file does not allow reading payroll data. Contact the company file administrator.
kinds.unavailable: MYOB is temporarily unavailable or rate-limited. Please try again shortly.
kinds.other: Could not read MYOB payslips. Please try again shortly.

empty.title: No paid payslips for this filter
empty.description: The store's employees may not have been paid yet, may not be matched to a MYOB card, or MYOB has no records in the range. Widen the dates, or check matching in Employee matching.

noPermission.title: You do not have permission to view payslips
noPermission.description: Payslips contain sensitive pay information. An administrator must grant "View payslips for managed stores" or "View payslips for all stores".

failed.title: Cannot read MYOB payslips right now
failed.reauth: The MYOB authorisation has expired or lacks scope (401). An administrator of the company file must re-authorise in MYOB integration.
failed.forbidden: This company file does not allow reading payroll data (403). Contact the company file administrator.
failed.unavailable: The MYOB service is temporarily unavailable or rate-limited. Payslips are not cached here; please try again shortly.
failed.other: Could not read MYOB payslips. Please try again shortly.

drawer.title: Payslip of {{name}}
drawer.notFound: This payslip cannot be found (you may no longer have access, or MYOB has corrected it).
drawer.samePaymentDate: This employee has {{count}} more payslips for other pay periods paid on the same date in this company file. Open them separately from the list.
drawer.noLines: This payslip has no detail lines.
drawer.disclaimerZh: 本工资单仅供查看，以 MYOB 发出的工资单为准。
drawer.disclaimerEn: For reference only. The official payslip is the one issued from MYOB.
drawer.logged: This view has been recorded; downloads and emails are recorded too (only who, which period and the recipient address; no amounts)
drawer.downloadFailed: Failed to download the payslip PDF. Please retry
drawer.downloadForbidden: You do not have permission to download payslip PDFs
drawer.paperCaption: The page above is exactly what the downloaded PDF and the email attachment contain

hours.title: Store assignment and our attendance hours
hours.sub: The payslip is issued by company, not by store · reference only, not in the PDF
hours.noStores: This payslip has no assignable store, so there are no attendance hours.
hours.loadFailed: Could not read our hours. Retry
hours.note: From our attendance (same basis as the payroll sheet). It can differ from the hours on the MYOB payslip above; MYOB is authoritative.

email.title: Send payslip PDF
email.subtitle: {{name}} · Pay period {{range}}
email.targetFailed: Could not load recipient details. Please retry
email.recipientDefaultHint: Defaults to the email in the employee profile
email.noProfileEmail: The employee profile has no email. The address entered here is used for this send only and is not saved to the profile.
email.changedWarning: This is different from the employee profile email ({{masked}}). Please check it before sending.
email.confirmRecipient: I have checked the recipient and confirm sending to this address (required to send)
email.copyToMeNone: Copy me (your account has no email)
email.subject: Subject
email.notePlaceholder: A short note to the employee, shown in the email body (do not include amounts)
email.info: The email carries the PDF only; the body contains no amounts. Each send is recorded in the view log: who, when, which period, which address.

errors.unconfirmed: The recipient differs from the profile email. Tick "I have checked the recipient" first.
errors.invalid: Invalid email address. Please check and retry.
errors.notConfigured: The company sender mailbox is not configured yet, so the email cannot be sent. The payslip itself is unaffected; download the PDF and send it manually.
errors.sendFailed: Send failed: the mail service is temporarily unavailable. The payslip itself is unaffected. Retry, or download the PDF and send it manually.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to email payslips.
errors.notFound: This payslip cannot be found (you may no longer have access, or MYOB has corrected it).
errors.other: Send failed. Please retry later. The payslip itself is unaffected; you can download the PDF and send it manually.
